faqs.q: What is the typical software engineer salary Sydney hourly rate under the Professional Employees Award?
faqs.a: Under the Professional Employees Award 2020, a Level 2 experienced professional earns $39.77 per hour, or $78,836 annually for 38 hours per week. Level 3 is $43.46/hour ($86,157/year) and Level 4 is $49.02/hour ($97,173/year). These are minimum rates; many employers pay above award.

faqs.q: How do I convert an hourly software engineer salary Sydney rate to annual pay?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours worked per week, then by 52 weeks. For a standard 38-hour week, use: hourly × 38 × 52. For example, $50/hour × 38 × 52 = $98,800 per year. Add 12% super on top for total remuneration.

faqs.q: What is the difference between base salary and total package for a software engineer salary Sydney?
faqs.a: A base salary has super paid on top (12% in 2026–27). A total remuneration package includes super inside it. For a $100,000 package, the taxable salary is about $89,286 (divide by 1.12). Take-home pay differs because tax applies to the salary, not the package.

bodyMarkdown:
## Software Engineer Salary Sydney: From Hourly to Annual

If you are negotiating a **software engineer salary Sydney** offer, you need to convert an hourly rate to annual pay, understand award minimums, and see what lands in your bank account after tax and super. This guide uses the Fair Work Ombudsman’s Professional Employees Award 2020 and the latest National Minimum Wage to show you the numbers.

### How to Convert Hourly to Annual Pay

The basic formula is:

**Annual gross = hourly rate × hours per week × 52 weeks**

We assume 38 ordinary hours per week, the standard full-time week under most awards and the National Minimum Wage. If your role regularly works more hours, adjust the figure. For a **software engineer salary Sydney** at $50 per hour:

$50 × 38 × 52 = $98,800 per year

This is your gross salary before tax and before super. Super is paid on top at 12% (the 2026–27 guarantee rate) up to the $270,830 maximum contribution base. So total remuneration would be $98,800 + $11,856 = $110,656.

### National Minimum Wage vs Award Rates

The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. Casual employees get a 25% loading, making the casual rate $33.05 per hour. However, most software engineers are covered by the **Professional Employees Award 2020**, which sets higher minimums.

Under that award:
- Level 1 Graduate (3-year degree): $33.71/hour, $66,825/year
- Level 2 Experienced Professional: $39.77/hour, $78,836/year
- Level 3 Professional/Senior: $43.46/hour, $86,157/year
- Level 4 Professional: $49.02/hour, $97,173/year

A **software engineer salary Sydney** at Level 2 is $78,836 per year. Many employers pay above award, but these are the legal minimums. The award also includes penalty rates for evening, Sunday, and public holiday work, plus overtime at time-and-a-half.

### Superannuation and Packaging

Super is paid **on top** of your base salary. If you see a total remuneration package (e.g., $105,000), it likely includes super. To find the taxable salary, divide by 1.12 (the super guarantee rate). For a $105,000 package:

$105,000 ÷ 1.12 = $93,750 taxable salary

Take-home pay is calculated on the taxable salary, not the package. A $95,000 base salary with 12% super ($11,400) gives $74,080 take-home, while a $105,000 package gives $73,230 take-home – the bigger headline is worth less. Always ask: “Is that base salary or total package?”

### Tax and Take-Home Pay

For 2026–27, the resident tax rates are:
- $0–$18,200: nil
- $18,201–$45,000: 15%
- $45,001–$135,000: 30%
- $135,001–$190,000: 37%
- Above $190,000: 45%

Plus the Medicare levy of 2% (single reduction thresholds not confirmed for 2026–27, so we use 2025–26 thresholds).

For a **software engineer salary Sydney** of $98,800 (from $50/hour):
- Tax: about $19,020 (using the scale)
- Medicare: $1,976
- Take-home: $77,804 per year
- Fortnightly: $2,992.46

### Fortnightly and Hourly Take-Home

Knowing your fortnightly take-home helps with budgeting. For the $50/hour example:
- Gross fortnight: $3,800
- Tax + Medicare: about $807
- Net fortnight: $2,993

Compare that to the National Minimum Wage: $26.44/hour gives $1,004.90/week, $2,009.80/fortnight gross, and about $1,730 take-home (after tax and Medicare). The award rate for a Level 2 software engineer ($39.77/hour) gives $1,511.26/week, $3,022.52/fortnight gross, take-home around $2,520.

### Casual Loading and Part-Time

If you work as a casual software engineer, you get a 25% loading on the award rate. For Level 2, that’s $39.77 × 1.25 = $49.71 per hour. Casual employees do not get paid leave, so the loading compensates. Part-time employees work fewer than 38 hours but get the same hourly rate and pro-rata leave.

### Using This Guide

Our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool lets you enter your rate and see annual, fortnightly, and after-tax figures. The [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) page compares award and national rates. For super and packaging details, see [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging).

Remember: this is an estimate. Your actual pay may include allowances, penalty rates, or salary sacrifice. Always check your award or agreement with the Fair Work Ombudsman.

### Summary

A **software engineer salary Sydney** at the Professional Employees Award Level 2 is $78,836 per year ($39.77/hour). At $50/hour, annual gross is $98,800, take-home about $77,804, plus $11,856 super. Use the formula hourly × 38 × 52 for annual, and divide by 26 for fortnightly. Compare offers on take-home pay, not headline numbers.
